headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate machine learning models to predict and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI package installations, including command expansion issues. Leverage natural language processing for improved documentation parsing and user guidance.
actions: Implement an AI model that analyzes package dependencies and historical data to flag potential vulnerabilities before installation.
Develop a feature using NLP techniques to automatically parse and explain complex `binding.gyp` files, reducing the risk of misconfiguration during installation
Create a real-time risk assessment dashboard that provides users with insights into the security and stability of packages based on public threat intelligence f
